race.title: The race
race.body: Everyone’s gain since the start of the period you pick, on one chart. Your line and the member you focus on are in colour, the others in grey.

periods.title: Periods and € / %
periods.body: The period sets where every gain starts, from today to all time. € counts the money earned. % lets a small portfolio win on performance.

today.title: Today and closes
today.body: Today moves every 30 minutes and stays dashed until the market closes. The standings use closing prices only.

record.title: Recording a change
record.body: Bought something last week? Record it with that day: FPR replays it from then.

cash.title: Cash
cash.body: Your cash only changes when you set it. Buying or selling never moves it, so set it again when money comes in or goes out.

search.title: Finding a share
search.body: Type a name, or paste an ISIN: FPR looks it up at its price provider.

manual.title: Manual shares
manual.body: A share nobody tracks gets its value from members. Anyone can update it.

missing.title: Missing prices
missing.body: A share whose prices haven’t arrived isn’t counted, never at €0, and the total says “incomplete”.

splits.title: Splits and dividends
splits.body: A split: record the new shares as a purchase on the split day. A dividend paid in cash: set your cash.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: The charts are drawn with TradingView Lightweight Charts™, made by TradingView.
credits.notice: TradingView Lightweight Charts™ Copyright (c) 2023 TradingView, Inc.

race.title: What the race shows
race.body: Each line is one member’s gain since the start of the period you picked. In %, a small portfolio can beat a big one. The dashed end is today: it becomes final at the market close.

unit.title: € or %
unit.body: € counts the money each member earned over the period. % compares their performance, so a small portfolio can beat a big one.

cash.title: Cash
cash.body: Cash only changes when it’s set. Buying or selling never moves it.

incomplete.title: Incomplete
incomplete.body: Some shares are still waiting for their prices. Until they arrive, they aren’t counted, never at €0.

manual.title: A manual share’s value
manual.body: No price provider tracks this share, so members enter its value by hand. Each value holds until someone adds the next one.
